description.value: The Beer Farmers is a farmhouse brewery and tasting room on a 4th-generation certified organic family farm in the Pemberton Valley, crafting lagers and ales from ingredients grown and malted on-site — one of very few breweries in the world to do so. The tasting room sits on a working farm with roots going back to 1895, offering a genuine farm-to-glass experience in a spacious, family- and dog-friendly outdoor setting. Touring cyclists riding the Pemberton Meadows Road will find food, locally crafted beer, and a welcoming atmosphere on a quiet agricultural road.

address.value: 8324 Pemberton Meadows Road, Pemberton, BC V0N 2L2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address, phone, and name exactly. The site confirms food is available and the tasting room is open daily, but mentions no bike-specific infrastructure (parking, pump, charging). The OSM opening_hours:pub tag shows winter-only schedule (Wed–Sun) while the website lists daily hours 12–8pm — a discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: OSM opening_hours:pub tag shows winter-only schedule (Wed–Fri 13:00–19:00; Sat–Sun 12:00–19:00), but the website lists Mon–Sun 12pm–8pm daily. OSM hours may be outdated or season-specific; website hours are preferred.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating farm brewery and tasting room with confirmed website presence, daily hours, food available, and a location directly on a cycling route in the Pemberton Valley.
